image.description: Filename of the normalized image in benchmark/images/

source_file.description: Original filename this was normalized from

labeled.description: Set true once a human has filled in sections. Unlabeled images are skipped by score.py.

attributes.description: Difficulty tags. The scorer breaks results down by these, so fill them in even before labeling items.

provenance.description: web = downloaded from the internet (clean, straight-on). field = photographed in a real venue. Report these separately; web-only accuracy overstates real-world performance.

script.description: brush = 筆文字, chalkboard = white-on-black handwriting

surface.description: tanzaku = 短冊 wall strips, digital = a PDF/graphic rather than a photograph

columns.description: Number of visual columns. Multi-column layouts with detached price columns are the hard price-binding case.

sections.description: Menu sections in reading order. Items with no section header go in a section with header_ja: null.

header_ja.description: Section header exactly as printed, e.g. 本日のおすすめ. null if the items sit under no header.

name_ja.description: Dish name exactly as printed, including okurigana. Exclude parenthetical notes — put those in note_ja.

reading.description: Hiragana reading. Optional at benchmark time; required later for the dictionary.

price.description: Yen, digits only. null when the item has no printed price.

price_note.description: Qualifier printed with the price, e.g. 各1本, 2人前, 時価

note_ja.description: Parenthetical detail printed with the item, e.g. バター醤油 or カレー or のりしお

decorative_text.description: Text that is NOT an item or a section header — shop name, slogans, tax notices, seat-charge notes, mascot dialogue. The parser must not emit these as items; listing them here lets the scorer flag that failure specifically.

notes.description: Free-text notes for the labeler: ambiguities, unreadable regions, judgment calls.
